title: Implement Union-Find in Python
description: Implement UnionFind with path compression and union by rank. Operations: find(x), union(x,y), connected(x,y).

files.tests/test_union_find.py:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from src.union_find import UnionFind


def test_basic_union_connected():
    uf = UnionFind(5)
    assert not uf.connected(0, 1)
    uf.union(0, 1)
    assert uf.connected(0, 1)
    assert not uf.connected(0, 2)


def test_transitive():
    uf = UnionFind(5)
    uf.union(0, 1)
    uf.union(1, 2)
    assert uf.connected(0, 2)
    assert not uf.connected(0, 3)


def test_self_connected():
    uf = UnionFind(3)
    assert uf.connected(0, 0)


def test_all_connected():
    uf = UnionFind(4)
    for i in range(3):
        uf.union(i, i + 1)
    assert uf.connected(0, 3)

task_spec.prompt:
Implement UnionFind in src/union_find.py:
- __init__(n): self.parent = list(range(n)); self.rank = [0]*n
- find(x): path compression — if self.parent[x] != x: self.parent[x] = self.find(self.parent[x]); return self.parent[x]
- union(x, y): find roots rx, ry; if rx==ry return; union by rank (attach smaller rank under larger; increment if equal)
- connected(x, y): return self.find(x) == self.find(y)
All 4 tests must pass.
